name: freellmapi
description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
one_liner: One API address that quietly pools together dozens of free AI-model providers, so you can use hundreds of free AI models without juggling separate accounts.
buyer: Honestly, the project itself says 'personal experimentation only' — there isn't a legitimate resale buyer here.
business_use_cases: A hobbyist developer prototypes AI features for free before deciding which paid provider to commit to.
A student experiments with many different LLMs for coursework without paying for API keys.
An indie hacker stress-tests prompt ideas across many free models before picking one to pay for in production.

money_ideas.idea: Build a paid 'model uptime monitoring' dashboard for developers who want visibility into which free providers are currently up — a legitimate meta-tool rather than reselling the free tiers themselves.

steal_this: Use it yourself to prototype for free, but don't build a resale business on it — the project explicitly says personal use only, and reselling pooled free-tier access breaks the providers' terms of service.
